metadata.name: gameplay_state
metadata.description: Gameplay State Tracking Program for on-chain game state management

instructions.name: close_game_state
docs: Closes the GameState account, returning rent to player.

instructions.name: heal_player
docs: Heals the player by a specified amount, authorized by poi-system.
This instruction can only be called via CPI from poi-system using
the poi_authority PDA as signer. Used for rest POI healing.
The max HP is derived from the player's inventory (equipped items).
HP is capped at the derived max_hp value.

instructions.name: modify_gold_authorized
docs: Modifies the player's gold by a delta value, authorized by poi-system.
This instruction can only be called via CPI from poi-system using
the poi_authority PDA as signer. Used for shop purchases, rerolls,
rusty anvil upgrades, and scrap chute costs.

accounts.name: poi_authority
docs: POI authority PDA from poi-system that must sign

instructions.name: move_player
docs: Moves the player to an adjacent tile with automatic combat resolution.
This instruction handles:
1. Movement validation (bounds, adjacency, move cost)
2. Night phase enemy movement (enemies within 3 tiles move toward player)
3. Combat triggered by enemy moving into player's tile
4. Combat triggered by player moving into enemy's tile
5. Phase advancement when moves are exhausted
Combat is resolved inline without CPI for compute efficiency.

docs: Gameplay authority PDA for signing CPI calls to map_generator

docs: Player inventory program for CPI (expand gear slots on boss victory)

accounts.name: map_generator_program
docs: Map generator program for CPI (set tile floor on wall break)

instructions.name: set_phase_for_testing
docs: TEST ONLY: Sets the game phase and moves remaining directly.
This instruction is intended for testing purposes to avoid
doing hundreds of move transactions to reach a specific phase.
WARNING: This should only be used in test environments.

instructions.name: skip_to_day
docs: Skips to the next Day phase, authorized by poi-system.
This instruction can only be called via CPI from poi-system using
the poi_authority PDA as signer. Used by rest POIs (L1 Mole Den, L5 Rest Alcove)
to skip the night phase.
Behavior:
- Night1 → Day2 (reset moves to DAY_MOVES)
- Night2 → Day3 (reset moves to DAY_MOVES)
- Night3 → triggers boss fight (cannot skip end-of-week boss)
Returns an error if called during a Day phase.

accounts.name: player

accounts.name: player_inventory_program

instructions.name: sync_hp_from_inventory
docs: Syncs HP to reflect current inventory bonuses.
This instruction should be called after equipping gear that provides +HP.
It calculates the new max_hp from the inventory and adjusts current HP:
- If player was at full base health (hp == BASE_HP), set hp to new max_hp
- If player was damaged, add the HP bonus (max_hp - BASE_HP) to current hp
- HP is always capped at the new max_hp
This ensures that equipping +HP gear immediately grants that HP.

accounts.name: inventory
docs: Player inventory for deriving max_hp (PDA derived from session)

accounts.name: player
docs: Player who owns this game state (burner wallet)

instructions.name: trigger_boss_fight
docs: Triggers and resolves the boss fight when conditions are met.
This instruction handles:
1. Validation that boss fight is ready (boss_fight_ready flag set)
2. Boss selection based on stored campaign_level and week
3. Combat resolution inline
4. Victory handling: week advancement or level completion
5. Defeat handling: player death persisted in state
Must be called after move sets boss_fight_ready = true.

types.name: CombatLog
docs: Detailed combat log for turn-by-turn visualization.
Contains a serialized vector of CombatLogEntry for replay.
Note: Solana logs have ~30KB limit; this compact format allows ~300-400 actions per battle.

Compact format to minimize data cost (~5 bytes per entry).

fields.name: extra

types.name: GameState
docs: Core gameplay state account linked to a GameSession.
Contains all mutable game data for a single run.
Stats (ATK, ARM, SPD, DIG, MaxHP) are derived from inventory at runtime.
PDA Seeds: ["game_state", session_pda.as_ref()]

types.name: GeneratedMap
docs: Generated map account storing tiles, enemies, and POI positions.
PDA seeds: ["generated_map", session.key()]
**Persistence invariant:** This account is session-scoped and its layout
(including `packed_tiles`) persists unchanged across week transitions.
Week advancement in gameplay-state only modifies `GameState.week` —
`packed_tiles` is never reset. Wall-to-floor conversions via `set_floor()`
write directly to `packed_tiles` and persist for the entire session.
